notable_quotes: The speed of crystallization controls formation of framework isomers in Zn(II)/1,2,4-triazol-3-amine systems.
Different aggregation fashions of Zn(II) and 1,2,4-triazol-3-amine produce distinct (3,4)-connected self-penetrating nets.
XRD patterns were compared after heating samples at 370 °C for one day with patterns simulated from single-crystal data to assess structural retention.
